title: Systematic Covariance Envelopes from Wasserstein Geometry: Evidence from Language-Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2410.23447v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Firm characteristics are commonly represented as fixed vectors, even though evidence about firms' operations arrives as heterogeneous collections of articles reports. We study how distances between distributions of firm characteristics restrict systematic covariance. For given latent exposure laws, quadratic Wasserstein geometry yields sharp covariance endpoints over admissible couplings. Under a common randomized bi-Lipschitz characteristic-to-exposure map, bounded risk-coordinate slack, and a maintained return-covariance bridge, characteristic-side distance yields a conditional interval for the covariance ceiling. Greater separation then leaves less scope for aligned systematic exposures when these assumptions are tight, while a non-negative transport excess term records the gap between realized and maximum-covariance arrangements. translated_title: 基于Wasserstein几何的系统性协方差包络：来自语言模型表示的证据
translated_abstract: 企业特征通常被表示为固定向量，然而关于企业经营状况的证据实际上是以异质的文章报道集合的形式到达的。我们研究企业特征分布之间的距离如何限制系统性协方差。对于给定的潜在暴露法则，二次Wasserstein几何在所有可行耦合之上给出尖锐的协方差端点。在一个共同的随机化双利普希茨特征-暴露映射、有界风险坐标松弛以及一个保持的收益-协方差桥接条件下，特征侧的距离为协方差上限产生一个条件区间。当这些假设较为紧致时，特征分布之间更大的分离度会为一致的系统性暴露留下更小的空间；同时，一个非负的传输超额项记录了实际协方差安排与最大协方差安排之间的差距。所得的包络是一种情景分析工具，而非关于期望收益、无套利或可识别性的论断。
tldr: 本文利用二次Wasserstein几何，在随机化双利普希茨特征-暴露映射等条件下，将企业特征分布之间的距离转化为系统性协方差上限的条件区间，证明特征分布越分离则一致性系统性暴露的空间越小，并以语言模型表示作为实证证据。
en_tdlr: Using quadratic Wasserstein geometry, this paper derives conditional intervals for the systematic covariance ceiling from distances between distributions of firm characteristics—showing that greater separation leaves less room for aligned systematic exposures—with evidence from language-model representations.
